question: Who was appointed as the next Director-General of UNESCO by its executive board? (October 2025)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khaled el-Enany.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **UNESCO’s executive board has appointed Khaled el-Enany, Egypt’s former antiquities and tourism minister, as the next Director-General of the organization.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khaled el-Enany is appointed as the Director-General following the vote by UNESCO's executive board.**
 
• **UNESCO, established in 1945, aims to promote peace and security through international cooperation in education, science, culture, and communication.**
 
• **The U.S. announced its withdrawal from UNESCO in July 2025, with the exit planned for December 2026.**
 
• **India has been a founding member of UNESCO since 1948, hosting two UNESCO offices.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UNESCO__

 __
 
• Founded in 1945, UNESCO’s mission is to promote peace through international collaboration in the fields of education, science, and culture.
 
 
 
• Khaled el-Enany__
 __
 
• Former antiquities and tourism minister of Egypt, appointed as UNESCO’s Director-General for his extensive background in cultural heritage and tourism.
 
 
 
• UNESCO Key Publications__
 
 
• Key reports published by UNESCO include the Global Education Monitoring Report and the UNESCO Science Report: Towards 2030.
